input.standard: ASTM E741 (tracer gas concentration decay, single zone); ASTM D6245 (occupant CO2 as tracer)
input.purpose: Measure V_lab, the volume of air served by scrubber-1-v6 in the Lab, as V = Qe * tau from a raise-then-decay CO2 curve with the occupants as the source.

steps.why: Rise: reduced effective flow (0.3 m3/min) so occupants' CO2 climbs several hundred ppm above the 1800 ppm start; never below the speed floor, never stopped.
Decay: full speed (Qe = 1 m3/min); record the decay towards equilibrium, about one tau (first guess V=30 m3, tau=30 min) or more, total stays within 60 min.

abort.when: the device refuses a step's command
battery state of charge under threshold
a monitored person leaves the band, monitoring is lost, or one more person enters the Lab

monitoring.reason: The three occupants of the Lab breathe the raised CO2 during the test.

expected.rise: With 3 occupants awake (3 x 0.38 = 1.14 L/min) and Qe=0.3 m3/min the equilibrium is about 3800 ppm above scrubber-zero, tau about 100 min at V=30 m3; over 20 min CO2 should rise from 1800 to about 2100-2300 ppm, staying under 3000 ppm.
expected.decay: At full speed Qe=1 m3/min the equilibrium is about 1140 ppm; C(t)=C_eq+(C_0-C_eq)exp(-t/tau) with tau=V/Qe, about 30 min if V=30 m3 (default guess, 10-200 m3 range). V_lab = Qe * tau fitted.
expected.hypothesis_fails: If the decay does not fit a single exponential towards about 1140 ppm, or hab-b CO2 moves in step with the Lab's, the closed hatch exchanges air (design 3 m3/min) and the zone is not single; a person moving or a change of occupancy also invalidates the curve. A CO2 reading at 3000 ppm or more before minute 20 means the volume is much smaller than guessed.

hypotheses: The hatch is held closed throughout; the exchange through the closed opening to Hab-B (design 3 m3/min per station-topology) is not measured here and is a hypothesis; the Hab-B CO2 is recorded every minute to show it.
The Lab air is well mixed (one zone) and the 3 occupants stay in the Lab at constant awake activity (0.38 L/min each, range 0.26-0.45).

The scrubber effective flow at full speed is 1 m3/min per datasheet (3.3 m3/min x 0.3) and scales with speed; its lag (3.33 min) is short against tau and the first minutes after a speed change are excluded from the fit.
Records: Lab CO2 and Hab-B CO2 every minute, speed commands and whether the device accepted them.
